scope: Isolated non-commercial comparison, no LoRAs, no live manifest promotion

controls.cooldown: Before each render, edge below 45C and junction below 55C continuously for 15 seconds; maximum wait 180 seconds, otherwise stop

order: For each task: baseline83, candidate83, candidate271, baseline271
feasibility: One orange-bowl image at seed71; excluded from scoring. Must pass guards, artifact checks and release before scored batch.

cases.prompt: A wide cel-shaded illustration of an elderly woman standing beside a young man at a quiet railway platform. Exactly two people, both shown head to toe. The woman wears a green coat and holds a closed yellow umbrella in her right hand; the man wears a purple coat and holds a red suitcase in his left hand. Clean ink outlines, flat colors, no lettering.
checks: woman right hand holds closed yellow umbrella
man left hand holds red suitcase
no clearly malformed visible hands or extra limbs

cases.prompt: A richly textured oil painting of a stone bridge crossing a narrow stream in a fantastical forest. A silver stag stands on the left bank and a small red fox stands on the right bank. Exactly two animals. Three glowing blue lanterns hang beneath the bridge. Moss, bark and wet stone remain visibly distinct. No text.
checks: exactly three blue lanterns under bridge

cases.prompt: A documentary photograph of one adult seated at a wooden table, shown from the waist up with their face and both hands completely visible. Their left hand rests palm-down with all five fingers spread separately on the table. Their right hand holds a plain white mug by its handle. Natural daylight, realistic skin, ordinary proportions, no text and no other people.
checks: five distinct fingers on left hand
right hand holds mug handle plausibly
no extra limbs or clearly malformed visible anatomy

cases.prompt: A wide realistic photograph of a small bookshop window. A rectangular sign above the window reads exactly NIGHT OWL BOOKS in clear white capital letters on navy blue. In the window exactly three books stand upright: orange on the left, green in the middle and violet on the right. Warm light inside, rainy pavement outside, no people and no other text.
checks: white letters on navy sign above window
orange left green middle violet right

review: Per-check met/not_met/uncertain; obscured anatomy is uncertain, not passed. Record all outputs, latency, memory, swap, thermals and release. Human aesthetic preference separate from agent compliance review.
limits: Native-setting pipeline comparison, not equal compute or distillation-only causal experiment. No cross-architecture paired-noise claim. Two seeds are screening evidence only. Guard refusal is not a quality failure. The prior editing test remains separate and incomplete.
